Stock market news | Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price

Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price, dropping to $79.42 on their fourth day of trading on Nasdaq. The stock fell 5.48% as an early post-listing rally faded, leaving shares down 31% from their peak.
